$comment: Shared URL-policy truth table for the Fastory Mobile SDK. Source of truth: this file (packages/sdk/fixtures/). Platform test suites embed a copy (SPM resources / test classpath / flutter test dir); the Dart fixtures_sync_test verifies every copy matches this source byte-for-byte. Cases with since=0.1 must pass today on every platform; cases with since=v1 are skipped until the owning feature ships (flip the flag to start its TDD loop). decision values: gameSheet | allow | external.
